title: Canonical ambient integral direct-image realization through strict towers
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its valuation ring, uniformizer and positive quotient rings $A_{E,n+1}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] and use their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $W=X,Y$, write $B_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$ for the completed commutative coefficient sheaf, $B_{n,W}=(A_{E,n+1})_W$ and $p_{n,W}:B_W\to B_{n,W}$ for its projections [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Coefficient and scheme universes are independent $u,t$, with ring and module sections in size $\max(u,t+1)$. Define $f_*^{\rm ring}$ by sectionwise precomposition along pro-etale base change. Define $c_n:B_{n,Y}\to f_*^{\rm ring}B_{n,X}$ as the sheafification adjunct of the literal constant-section map. There is a unique $c_f:B_Y\to f_*^{\rm ring}B_X$ satisfying $c_f\, f_*^{\rm ring}(p_{n,X})=p_{n,Y}\,c_n$ for every $n\ge0$; take this unique map. Define $f_*^B:\operatorname{Mod}(B_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(B_Y)$ by sectionwise precomposition and restriction of scalars along $c_f$. This functor is additive. Define $T_f$ on actual strict towers of completed modules by applying $f_*^B$ to each term and transition, and let $RT_f$ be its unbounded total right derived functor on simultaneous K-injective tower resolutions. Use the canonical strict coefficient-system categories, exact scalar-restriction functor $U_X$ and total derived inverse limit $L_Y$ of [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], realizing the derived limit of [def-weil-derived-limit]. Let $\mathcal R_X$ be the reduction field of the recorded calculus of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], left adjoint to the fixed coefficient-system limit functor and normalized on a flat-term K-flat representative by its actual quotient system; its evaluations are the derived reductions of [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Define the ambient integral direct-image realization by the actual composite
$$F_f=\mathcal R_X\,D(U_X)\,RT_f\,L_Y:
D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_X))\longrightarrow D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_Y)).$$
This realizes the formula of [def-weil-derived-direct-image] on arbitrary ambient inputs: the tower terms are $\operatorname{Res}_n Rf_{*,n}(K\otimes^L_{B_X}B_{n,X})$ with their actual quotient transitions, followed by total derived inverse limit. No boundedness, constructibility or derived completeness restriction is imposed in this definition. The reduction is determined up to natural isomorphism by the fixed-limit adjunction, and the structural coefficient map is determined uniquely by the finite projection equations; no arbitrary functor or coefficient map is supplied as data.

proof.text: Construct the finite-level transition maps as a natural transformation between the inverse systems, using naturality of the sheafification adjunction and the constant-section direct image.
Apply preservation of the inverse limit by the sectionwise direct-image functor to lift the cone to a morphism of completed commutative ring sheaves.
Use the limit hom_ext principle and the forgetful sheaf functor injectivity to prove the finite-coordinate characterization and uniqueness.
For module maps, evaluate the pushforward on sections; the resulting functions are precomposition maps, so addition is preserved definitionally.
